references.title: 全勤獎金 (full-attendance bonus): the amount is the contract's (keyed on the employment terms); the law only limits what leave may take from it. 勞工請假規則 §9 (https://law.moj.gov.tw/LawClass/LawSingle.aspx?pcode=N0030006&flno=9, in this form from 2026-01-01, read 2026-09-30): (1) 婚假、喪假、公傷病假及公假, 妊娠未滿三個月流產未請產假而請普通傷病假, and 依第七條 親自照顧家庭成員 事假 are not 缺勤 and cannot affect it; (2) other 普通傷病假 takes it only 按請普通傷病假日數依比例計算 — MOL Q&A (https://www.mol.gov.tw/1607/28162/28166/28180/86983/87103/post, updated 2026-01-09): at most bonus ÷ 30 per sick day. 性別平等工作法 §21(2) likewise protects 生理假, 產假, 陪產檢及陪產假, 產檢假, 家庭照顧假 and the other §14–§20 leaves (https://law.moj.gov.tw/LawClass/LawAll.aspx?pcode=N0030014). Owner rule 2026-09-28 defaults (law silent): each SICK_LEAVE, HOSPITALISED_SICK_LEAVE or ordinary PERSONAL_LEAVE (事假 not for family care, which the law leaves to the contract) working day in the window takes bonus ÷ 30, the deduction floored to the 元 so it never exceeds the ratio, never below nothing; every other leave takes nothing; an unpaid day does not prorate it again (`npl_prorates` false). A 2025-12 version applies the same arithmetic: before 2026 the rule protected fewer leaves but a pro-rata cut was always lawful. A sick-leave day taken for a miscarriage under three months without maternity leave (§9(1)(2)) is recorded with entry facts miscarriage_under_three_months and takes nothing. It is 工資 (勞動基準法 §2(3): 經常性給與), so it enters the insured wages, the §56 reserve wage and 薪資所得 as the meal allowance does, without the meal exemption. It is ordinary salary: the allowance stays on ORDINARY_WAGES and never on ADDITIONAL_WAGES.

Law-audit decision 2026-11-13: the ÷ 30 cut of the 2026-09-28 rule is not applied. The allowance program reads no leave (src/lib/payroll_engine/programs.ts), and paying the bonus whole is lawful under 勞工請假規則 §9, which only limits a cut.

references.title: 勞工保險條例
references.quote: Ordinary-risk premium rate 12.5%, cut by 1% for every insured: 11.5% with the 1% employment insurance premium under 就業保險法 §41(2), and 11.5% alone outside employment insurance (行政院 91-12-27 院臺勞字第0910061906號函; BLI 分擔金額表 自115年1月1日起適用, https://www.bli.gov.tw/Files/25693, grade 29,500 at 679 / 2,375), shared 20% employee, 70% employer and 10% government. Insured on the grade of the contract's monthly wage (base salary with its fixed allowances), or the declared insured amount — never re-graded from a month's reduced pay; notified adjustments take effect on the first of the following month. A contract paid by the hour, day or piece reads the month's wages until its three-month-average declaration is recorded. A part-timer below the minimum wage takes the lower grades; a sheltered worker's grade is recorded as insured_amount. Each side and each scheme is rounded alone, so LI plus EI reproduces every cell of the BLI 分擔金額表, on a 30-day month: a joiner from the join date, a leaver to the exit date, the last day of a month completing 30; 育嬰留職停薪 days are left out. Registered continuing cover remains chargeable after age 65. Nothing in a unit of fewer than five workers that never entered compulsory cover (§6, §8).

LI.description: Labour insurance premium: 11.5% of the insured salary grade for the days covered in the month, shared 20% by the worker, 70% by the employer and 10% by the government (勞工保險條例 §13–15).

references.title: 勞動基準法
references.quote: Wage arrears fund: 0.025% of the unit's total 墊償提繳薪資 — each worker's LI-equivalent insured salary prorated by covered days on a 30-day month, 育嬰留職停薪 days left out, including workers covered only by employment or occupational accident insurance — rounded once to the nearest whole dollar at company level.

references.title: 就業保險法

Priced on the wage's LI grade, prorated by covered days and left out on 育嬰留職停薪 days, as LI (§40). Coverage cannot precede the fifteenth birthday (§5); apply the later of declared cover and birthday.

EI.description: Employment insurance premium: 1% of the insured salary for the days covered in the month, shared 20% by the worker, 70% by the employer and 10% by the government; for covered workers under 65 (就業保險法 §5, §40).

references.title: 全民健康保險法; 施行細則
references.quote: Regular premiums use the declared insured amount at the month-end insuring unit: charged for the whole month by the unit insuring the worker on its last day (NHIA 保險費計收: 當月最末日在保) — nothing in a month the worker left before its last day, a whole month for a joiner. Employee pays 30% of the 5.17% premium for self and up to three enrolled dependants; published whole-dollar per-person premiums apply. Employer pays 60% with the published 1.56 average dependant factor.

references.title: 全民健康保險保險費負擔金額表

references.title: 全民健康保險法
references.quote: Bonuses exceeding four times the current insured amount (the year's bonuses above four times the insured grade) attract a 2.11% supplementary premium, limited to the current payment and NT$10 million of assessable bonus per payment. After departure, retain the insured amount at withdrawal. The regular month-end premium being zero does not remove this threshold. Round once to whole NT dollars.

NHI_SUPPLEMENT.description: Supplementary health insurance premium of 2.11% on the part of the year's bonuses above four times the worker's insured amount, withheld from the bonus (全民健康保險法 §31).

references.title: 全民健康保險法
references.quote: Salary income (薪資所得, 所得稅格式代號 50) paid to a person who is not insured through this unit (兼職薪資所得) attracts the 2.11% supplementary premium, withheld at payment by the payer (§31(1) 扣費義務人). Each payment (the slip's salary income as one payment, with the exempt NT$3,000 of a meal allowance and overtime within the 勞基法§32 limits left out of 所得稅法§14 薪資所得; each bonus or leave-pay line as its own) is charged whole when it reaches the NT$28,590 minimum wage, at most NT$10,000,000 a payment. Non-compete compensation paid after the exit is salary to a person no longer insured through this unit, so it is charged whatever the NHI election (owner ruling: salary income). A worker insured through this unit is outside this premium.

references.title: 全民健康保險署 二代健保補充保險費簡介 (115.01.05 版)
references.quote: The rate is 2.11% from 1 January 2021; from 1 September 2014 a single payment below the basic (minimum) wage is not withheld on, so a payment at or above the NT$28,590 minimum wage is charged whole; a single payment is assessed on at most NT$10,000,000; 第2類 insureds' salary income and persons with no NHI eligibility or 第5類 insureds are exempt.

Covered: nationals, permanent residents and foreign spouses; a national continuously employed by the same unit before 1 July 2005 may retain the LSA old pension system under §8–9, with the 2005 election or deemed continuation and same-unit history evidenced by the nonregistration declaration; the LSA §56 employer reserve still applies. An employee may voluntarily contribute up to 6% (§14(3): 每月工資百分之六範圍內; the default is none). Contribution wage is the 月提繳工資分級表 grade; contributed from the day of joining to the day of leaving by days on a 30-day month (§16), stopped on 育嬰留職停薪 days (§20); rounded after proration. references.locator: 所得稅法§88; 扣繳率標準§2; 扣繳辦法§6–7
references.quote: Resident regular salary is assessed on the full month's payments, separately from non-monthly bonus payments. With a declared 免稅額申報表 (spouse/dependant count) the 114年度 薪資所得扣繳稅額表 applies (財政部 113年12月 台財稅字第11304679670號函): NT$97,000 personal exemption, NT$262,000 married standard deduction and NT$218,000 salary deduction. 500-dollar rows to 500,000, tax truncated to NT$10, nothing at 2,000 or less; salaries above NT$500,000 or more than eleven spouse and dependants use the annualised formula in 說明(三), truncated to NT$1. A worker with no reviewed tax residence for the payment year is refused, never withheld at nil. Without the declaration, 5% (art.6), truncated to whole NT dollars before applying the NT$2,000 exemption; NT$40,020 is the first whole-dollar salary requiring withholding. references.title: 勞動基準法第38條 — 3 days after six months' continuous service, 7 after one year, 10 after two, 14 after three, 15 after five and one further day for every year beyond ten, capped at 30; the worker schedules the days and any unused day is paid out at the year end or on termination. 僱用部分時間工作勞工應行注意事項 (MOL, amended 2022-03-14) 三(三)–(四): a part-timer’s 特別休假 is their normal hours a year over a full-timer’s × the LSA §38 days, and 婚喪事病假 hours are their average weekly hours ÷ 40 × the days × 8. `entitlement.scale` states both in the part-timer’s own days (× 8 ÷ their hours a day), so a part-timer working the full-timer’s five days on shorter hours keeps the §38 days, as the guideline’s proviso requires. The guideline says “得參考” (may be referred to): it is MOL guidance, not a statute. 勞動基準法第38條第4項: 特別休假因年度終結而未休之日數，雇主應發給工資; 施行細則第24條之1第2項第1款: 年度終結者於契約約定之工資給付日發給或於年度終結後三十日內發給. The unused days are raised by its schedule on the leave year’s last day; a deferral the parties agreed under §38(4) is HR’s to record by rejecting the request and waiving the duty with its reason.

references.quote: Ordinary-risk premium rate 12.5%, cut by 1% for every insured: 11.5% with the 1% employment insurance premium under 就業保險法 §41(2), and 11.5% alone outside employment insurance (行政院 91-12-27 院臺勞字第0910061906號函; BLI 分擔金額表 自115年1月1日起適用, https://www.bli.gov.tw/Files/25693, grade 29,500 at 679 / 2,375), shared 20% employee, 70% employer and 10% government. A contract paid by the hour, day or piece reads the month's wages until its three-month-average declaration is recorded. A part-timer below the minimum wage takes the lower grades; a sheltered worker's grade is recorded as insured_amount. Each side and each scheme is rounded alone, so LI plus EI reproduces every cell of the BLI 分擔金額表, on a 30-day month: a joiner from the join date, a leaver to the exit date, the last day of a month completing 30; 育嬰留職停薪 days are left out. Registered continuing cover remains chargeable after age 65. Nothing in a unit of fewer than five workers that never entered compulsory cover (§6, §8).
